This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes & support for WhatsApp 26.41
- Fixed viewed statuses being marked as seen for their sender after relaunching WhatsApp with Mark as Viewed enabled.
- Fixed a crash when viewing some statuses with the Download or Mark as Viewed buttons enabled.
- Fixed Allow View Once Screenshot/Recording not working on newer WhatsApp versions.

This update contains the following changes:

- Bug fixes & support for WhatsApp 26.41.X
- Fixed Status Archive not saving your statuses or their viewers on WhatsApp's new internal status storage.
- Fixed a crash when viewing a status from the Statuses Bar.
